item: lyrics-page (Android port, branch android-int-oct3 @ 90d32ca): Synced/Static become Translate · Sing; synced vs plain is picked automatically, with a "Show as plain text" switch in the More sheet; the screen always stays on while lyrics are open; real Liquid Glass for the lyrics chrome and More sheet in glass mode, with the same features styled as Material in Material mode.
currentBehaviour:
All paths are under app/src/main/java/com/theveloper/pixelplay/ unless noted. Every citation below was read on base 90d32ca.

TOOLBAR
- The lyrics screen is LyricsSheet, composed by FullPlayerContent.kt:1062-1121.
- Its bottom cluster (LyricsSheet.kt:1280-1407) has three parts:
  - an optional FloatingInstrumentalToggle (1321-1338, defined at 1606-1663), shown only when a render exists;
  - play/pause (1409-1448) and the seek bar (1574-1604);
  - LyricsFloatingToolbar (LyricsFloatingToolbar.kt:58-180): Back · Synced · Static · More.
- The two segments are ToggleSegmentButton(text) (LyricsFloatingToolbar.kt:133-161). With no lyrics, a 50 dp spacer replaces them (125-126).
- The labels are R.string.lyrics_mode_synced and lyrics_mode_static (values/strings_player.xml:132-133). Nothing else uses them.

SYNCED VS PLAIN
- `var showSyncedLyrics by remember(lyrics)` (LyricsSheet.kt:394-402) already picks synced lyrics when they exist, otherwise plain. The segments only override it, and the override resets when the lyrics change.
- Plain lines come from Lyrics.plain. LyricsUtils.kt:894-901 builds them from the synced lines plus "\n"-joined romanization and translation. LyricsDoc.toLyrics() (data/model/LyricsDoc.kt:16-17) uses the text only.

KEEP SCREEN ON
- LyricsSheet.kt:348-384 reads the raw DataStore key "keep_screen_on_lyrics" (default false) and sets View.keepScreenOn.
- ON_STOP turns the preference itself off (363-373).
- A registered ACTION_SCREEN_OFF receiver also turns it off (444-461).
- The More sheet switch is at LyricsMoreBottomSheet.kt:82-83 (params), 470-480 (corner logic) and 660-700 (row, R.string.lyrics_controls_keep_screen_on). LyricsSheet wires it at 1085-1093.
- The string exists in 12 locales. There is also an orphan lyrics_more_keep_screen_on in values-ar/strings_components.xml:26.
- The sync editor already keeps the screen on with the window flag FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON for its whole session (presentation/lyrics/sync/LyricsSyncEditorOverlay.kt:198-212).
- FullPlayerContent stays composed after the player collapses (scoped/FullPlayerCompositionPolicy.kt:40-90). showLyricsSheet (FullPlayerContent.kt:261) is not reset on collapse.

BACKUP
- Global settings are generic. exportPreferencesForBackup dumps every DataStore key except INITIAL_SETUP_DONE (UserPreferencesRepository.kt:126-128, 1541-1559). importPreferencesFromBackup writes any key back (1561-1595).
- So old backups already restore keep_screen_on_lyrics silently, and today's exports contain it.
- Restore previews show plan.warnings (BackupManager.kt:101-157; BackupModuleSelectionDialog.kt:379). Module validation already emits per-entry WARNINGs for preference arrays (data/backup/validation/ModuleSchemaValidator.kt:72-77, 373-387). WARNINGs never block a restore (RestoreExecutor.kt:78).

TRANSLATION
- Only AI translation exists: More sheet row → PlayerViewModel.translateLyricsViaAi (PlayerViewModel.kt:3259-3271) → LyricsStateHolder.translateLyricsViaAi (LyricsStateHolder.kt:405-470) → AiStateHolder.translateLyrics (AiStateHolder.kt:287-320). It imports a dual-timestamp LRC and persists it.
- There is no on-device translator. No ML Kit dependency exists in gradle/libs.versions.toml.
- SyncedLine.translation (data/model/Lyrics.kt:21-28) feeds PreparedLyricsBuilder on both the LRC path (:180) and the LyricsDoc path (extrasByStart by start time, :89-92, :146).
- LyricsStateHolder rebuilds prepared lyrics whenever stablePlayerState.lyrics changes identity (LyricsStateHolder.kt:133-156).
- Visibility comes from DataStore "show_lyrics_translation" / "show_lyrics_romanization", default true (presentation/lyrics/LyricsAppearancePrefs.kt:81-83). Both are toggled in the More sheet (LyricsMoreBottomSheet.kt:534-614).

INSTRUMENTAL
- _studioInstrumentalActive and _studioInstrumentalAvailable live in PlayerViewModel (256-263). This is against the state-holder rule.
- switchToStudioInstrumental / switchToOriginalAudio send a MusicService custom command (3072-3099). Both reset on song change (3111-3124, collected at 929-934).
- Rendering is StemSeparatorWorker:
  - unique tag uniqueWorkName(songId) (data/worker/StemSeparatorWorker.kt:145);
  - PROGRESS_PERCENT / PROGRESS_DETAIL (:119, 138-139);
  - OUTPUT_FAILURE_REASON / OUTPUT_INSTRUMENTAL_PATH (:141-142);
  - enqueue with KEEP (:177-185).
- The UI observes it per song in InstrumentalRenderAction (components/tais/InstrumentalRenderAction.kt:50-67, 92-102; this is the no-lyrics state, LyricsSheet.kt:1540) and in TaisJobRow (TaisStudioProgressCard.kt:218-280).
- After a render, nothing refreshes `available` unless the UI calls switchToStudioInstrumental.

GLASS (LocalGlassModeEnabled)
- The header capsule and the cluster are two kyant GlassPanels sampling a layerBackdrop of LyricsArtworkBackground (LyricsSheet.kt:666-670, 804-811, 1195-1259). The comment says "at most two glass nodes".
- Tints are Black@0.22, or Black@0.35 over bright art (1264-1265).
- Inside the heavy cluster panel everything is a fill:
  - pills are White@0.08 (1268, 1310);
  - play/pause is an opaque tertiaryFixedDim squircle (1368-1373);
  - the active segment is opaque chrome.selected (1399);
  - the sync chip and the instrumental toggle are fake glass (fill plus rim; 1814-1857, 1628-1640);
  - the show-controls disc and the swipe overlay are opaque chrome.emphasis (1453-1482, 1035-1043).
- The artwork background redraws at up to 30 fps (lyrics/background/LyricsArtworkBackground.kt:66), so every lens sampling it re-renders at that rate.
- By contrast, the full player's glass uses:
  - MediaOrb transport lit with the accent while playing (player/GlassPlayerControls.kt:54-100);
  - LiquidChip toggles flooded with the accent (107-150);
  - top-bar pills tinted palette.tintSubtle, White@0.08 dark (156-182; GlassPalette.kt:64-85).

MORE SHEET
- LyricsMoreBottomSheet → AdaptiveModalBottomSheet (GlassAdaptive.kt:289-386). In glass mode it is already a heavy GlassPanel sampling the window-aligned baked app ambient (a separate window; it cannot sample the lyrics art). It is bottom-anchored with top-only 32 dp corners (222-223).
- It is opened with skipPartiallyExpanded = true (LyricsSheet.kt:425-427).
- Rows are soft fills: contentColor@0.08 (LyricsMoreBottomSheet.kt:138).
- The alignment picker uses ToggleSegmentButtons whose inactive fill is the opaque surfaceContainerLow (386-463).
- The shuffle/repeat/heart row is the Material BottomToggleRow (706-726; player/BottomToggleRow.kt) in both modes.
- The AI lyric-sync row is at 290-300.
rootCause:
This is a port, not a bug. Android differs from the owner's decisions in four places:
- The toolbar still offers the manual Synced/Static override (LyricsFloatingToolbar.kt:125-161). Vocals-off is a separate floating pill that appears only after a render.
- Keep screen on is an opt-in preference that switches itself off on ON_STOP and on screen-off (LyricsSheet.kt:348-384, 444-461).
- On-device translation does not exist, only cloud/AI translation that rewrites the stored LRC.
- In glass mode, the controls inside the single heavy cluster panel are opaque or low-alpha fills:
  - play/pause is solid tertiaryFixedDim;
  - the active segment is solid primaryFixedDim;
  - the panel tint is Black@0.22.
  The full player instead uses MediaOrb, LiquidChip and tintSubtle glass. The More sheet's alignment picker and toggle row are Material fills on glass. So the page reads as tinted plastic rather than Liquid Glass, which is the same symptom the owner flagged on iOS.

Android-specific constraints the plan must respect:
- Any extra lens over the lyrics art re-renders at 30 fps (LyricsArtworkBackground.kt:66). The G4 comment caps it at 2 nodes (LyricsSheet.kt:666).
- A ModalBottomSheet window cannot sample the lyrics layerBackdrop (GlassWindowBackdrop.kt doc).
- LocalGlassPalette follows the app's light/dark setting. Kit controls dropped onto the always-dark lyrics art in a light-themed app would draw black text unless the dark palette is forced.
- The full player stays composed while collapsed (FullPlayerCompositionPolicy.kt:40-90). An unconditional keep-screen-on in LyricsSheet would keep the phone awake in the library if lyrics were left open.

recommendedPlan.change:
Add ML Kit on-device translation and language ID.
- Versions: mlkitTranslate = "17.0.3" and mlkitLanguageId = "17.0.6".
- Libraries: mlkit-translate = { module = "com.google.mlkit:translate", version.ref = "mlkitTranslate" } and mlkit-language-id = { module = "com.google.mlkit:language-id", version.ref = "mlkitLanguageId" } (both minSdk 23; this app's minSdk is 30, app/build.gradle.kts:116).
- Add implementation(libs.mlkit.translate) and implementation(libs.mlkit.language.id) next to the AI deps (~:352).
- Use kotlinx.coroutines.tasks.await, already on the classpath (libs.versions.toml:272; build.gradle.kts:344).
- After adding, run :app:assembleDebug -Ppixelplay.enableAbiSplits=true. Check mergeDebugNativeLibs for duplicate .so paths against tensorflow-lite 2.17 / litert 2.2 / onnxruntime, and record the APK size delta in the handoff.

`fun Lyrics.withTranslations(byLine: Map<String, String>): Lyrics`:
- Sets SyncedLine.translation for matching line text and leaves other lines untouched.
- Rebuilds `plain` from synced exactly like LyricsUtils.kt:894-900 (line, \n romanization, \n translation), so "Show as plain text" also shows the translations.
- Keeps `document` as is: PreparedLyricsBuilder takes translations from synced by start time on the doc path (:89-92, :146).
- Never translates lines already carrying a translation.
- Also `fun resolveLyricsDisplay(lyrics: Lyrics?, plainOverride: Boolean): LyricsDisplay` (SYNCED / PLAIN / NONE): synced when synced is non-empty and there is no override; plain when plain is non-empty, or when the override is on (falling back to synced line texts if plain is empty); else NONE.

Inject @ApplicationContext context, PlaybackStateHolder and OnDeviceLyricsTranslator.

Expose:
- `state: StateFlow<LyricsTranslateUiState>` (songId, phase Idle | DownloadingModel(languageName) | Translating | Failed);
- `messages: SharedFlow<String>`;
- `fun translateCurrent()`;
- `fun initialize(scope)`, called from PlayerViewModel init next to lyricsStateHolder.initialize (PlayerViewModel.kt:802).

translateCurrent():
1. Take the current song and lyrics from playbackStateHolder.stablePlayerState.
2. Require synced lines. This matches the iOS default; plain-only lyrics leave Translate disabled.
3. Target is the PHONE's language: Resources.getSystem().configuration.locales[0] (owner: 'phone's language only'; AiStateHolder.kt:289 uses the app locale instead).
4. Identify the dominant source on ~40 joined lines.
   - null → message "Couldn't tell which language these lyrics are in".
   - source == target → R.string.lyrics_translate_already_in_target_language.
   - unsupported → message.
5. If the model isn't downloaded, set DownloadingModel and toast "Downloading <Language> translation (about 30 MB)…".
6. Translate unique lines, skipping lines that identify as the target language (mixed K-pop/English lyrics).
7. Apply with withTranslations through playbackStateHolder.updateStablePlayerState { if (it.currentSong?.id == songId) it.copy(lyrics = translated) else it }, which discards a stale result after a song change.
8. Set DataStore show_lyrics_translation = true (context.dataStore, data/preferences dataStore extension, as LyricsSheet.kt:1108-1111 does).

Caching and cancellation:
- Keep translations in a session LRU (~30 songs) of songId → line map.
- In initialize(), collect stablePlayerState.map { currentSong?.id to lyrics } with distinctUntilChanged on identity (pattern from LyricsStateHolder.kt:137-140). Re-apply a cached map when the same song's lyrics reload without translations.
- Cancel the running job on song change.
- Never persist to the song file. The AI path keeps persisting.

Move the instrumental state out of PlayerViewModel, as the AGENTS.md rule requires.

Holder:
- Owns `active` and `available` (today PlayerViewModel.kt:256-263) and a `pendingSongId`.
- Inject @ApplicationContext context (WorkManager), PlaybackStateHolder, CastStateHolder (isRemotePlaybackActive / isCastConnecting) and SpotifyConnectStateHolder (playingOnName, SpotifyConnectStateHolder.kt:45-48).
- Exposes `ui: StateFlow<SingUi>` built by flatMapLatest on current song id → WorkManager.getInstance(context).getWorkInfosByTagFlow(StemSeparatorWorker.uniqueWorkName(songId)). Pick the job the way TaisStudioProgressCard.kt:242-251 does: the first unfinished job, else the newest by REQUEST_CREATED_TAG.
- Pure, unit-tested reducer `fun singUi(available, active, job: JobSnapshot?, remoteActive): SingUi` returning label, active, enabled, progress 0..1 or null, and an optional failure.
- On a SUCCEEDED job for the current song: set available = true. If pendingSongId == songId, emit `switchRequests: SharedFlow<String>` (OUTPUT_INSTRUMENTAL_PATH) once per WorkInfo id, then clear pending.
- FAILED → message with OUTPUT_FAILURE_REASON.
- `fun onSingTapped(song)`:
  - remoteActive → message "Sing works on this phone only. Switch playback back to this phone first.";
  - active → request original;
  - available → request instrumental at TaisInstrumentalIndex.bestAvailableFile;
  - job running → no-op;
  - else → pendingSongId = song.id and StemSeparatorWorker.enqueue(workManager, song.id, song.contentUriString), as InstrumentalRenderAction.kt:100 does.
- A new song clears pending (vocals return per song, as the iOS plan says).

recommendedPlan.file: app/src/test/... (new and extended unit tests) + handoff/2026-10-07-lyrics-page-android.md

risks: Performance: every lens over the lyrics art re-renders at the background's 30 fps (LyricsArtworkBackground.kt:66). The plan goes from 2 to 4 nodes, or 5 while sync controls show. Do not give each toolbar button its own glass without measuring (8-9 lenses). Use PerformanceMetrics and gfxinfo on the Pixel 10 Pro, after asking the owner.

Light app theme plus glass mode: LocalGlassPalette is Light (black text). The lyrics chrome must force GlassPalette.of(isDark = true, …), or MediaOrb icons and LiquidSegmented labels go unreadable over the dark art. The More sheet sits in its own window over the app ambient, so it legitimately follows the app palette.

The More sheet is a separate window. Its glass refracts the baked app ambient, which is derived from the same album art, not the moving lyrics art behind it. If the owner still finds it 'not glass', the only true fix is an in-window sheet drawn inside LyricsSheet with backdrop = lyricsGlassBackdrop, plus its own drag-to-dismiss and BackHandler ordering against LyricsPredictiveBackHandler. That is an M-size follow-up; see the owner decisions.

Keep screen on: FullPlayerContent stays composed when the player collapses (FullPlayerCompositionPolicy.kt:40-90), so the effect must be gated on currentSheetState == EXPANDED. View.keepScreenOn and the sync editor's window flag are independent. Do not switch LyricsSheet to the window flag, or LyricsSheet's onDispose would clear the editor's flag (LyricsSyncEditorOverlay.kt:199-201 explains this).

PlainLyricsLine (LyricsSheet.kt:1677-1700) treats a Latin second line under a CJK/Hangul line as romanization. A rebuilt plain line with a Latin translation and no romanization (the LyricsDoc path) shows the translation in the romanization slot, hidden by the romanization toggle. The style is identical, but call this out in testing.

Sing:
- The first render runs StemSeparatorWorker in the foreground for minutes and may download Spotify-matched audio first (StemSeparatorWorker.kt:74-83).
- Auto-switch must fire once per WorkInfo id and only for the same current song.
- An automatic quiet job is cancelled by user enqueue (:179), so state can flip from running to cancelled to queued.
- Disable Sing during Cast and Spotify Connect: the audio override is local only.

Moving _studioInstrumentalActive/Available out of PlayerViewModel touches 3072-3124 and FullPlayerContent.kt:1066-1080. Adding two holders to PlayerViewModel's constructor breaks PlayerViewModelTest (:282-321) until it passes relaxed mocks with stubbed SharedFlows (relaxed SharedFlow mocks collected in init can hang).
Partial-height glass More sheet: the shuffle/repeat/heart row and lower Controls rows are hidden until the user drags the sheet up. Accepted on iOS, but call it out to the owner.

Manual checks on the Pixel 10 Pro, only after asking the owner:
- Set screen timeout to 15 s. Lyrics open, playing and paused: the screen stays on. Collapse the player: it sleeps. Open the sync editor: it stays on.
- Translate on a foreign-language synced song: model download toast, then translation shown. Tap toggles visibility. Long-press shows Translate via AI and Show romanization.
- Sing on a fresh song: progress, then vocals off automatically. Tap returns vocals. Disabled while Spotify Connect or Cast plays.
- Show as plain text resets on song change.
- Glass mode in both light and dark app themes: orb lit while playing, active segment flooded, floating partial glass More sheet with LiquidSegmented and LiquidChips.
- Material mode: same features, Material styling.
- Restore an old backup containing keep_screen_on_lyrics: a preview warning appears and the key is absent afterwards.
ownerDecisions: On-device Translate engine: Android has no system translator Claude can rely on. (A) Google ML Kit on-device translation: free, well documented, about 30 MB per language downloaded the first time, a few MB more in the app. Suggested. (B) Android's built-in translation service (the one Pixel's Live Translate uses): no extra library, but undocumented for third-party apps, so it may simply not work. Claude would only try it after A ships.
Translation model download: allow it on mobile data with a 'Downloading <language> (about 30 MB)' notice (suggested; you tapped Translate on purpose), or Wi-Fi only?

Glass lyrics toolbar: (a) play/pause as a lit glass orb, a glass seek bar, and ONE glass bar holding Back · Translate · Sing · More with the active button flooded in the album colour. Suggested: 4 glass layers redrawn 30 times a second over the moving art. (b) Every button its own glass bubble, as on iPhone: more liquid, but 8-9 glass layers over moving art, so it needs a battery and smoothness check on your Pixel first.

Glass More sheet: (a) keep it as a floating, half-height glass sheet. It bends the app's album-coloured background rather than the moving lyrics art exactly behind it (suggested, small). (b) Draw it inside the lyrics screen so it bends the actual moving artwork: truer glass, but a medium-sized rebuild of the sheet's drag and back handling.
Old backups with the 'Keep screen on' lyrics setting: show 'will be skipped' in the restore preview (suggested, matches iPhone), or ignore it silently?
Translate for plain (unsynced) lyrics: keep it disabled as on iPhone (suggested), or let Android also translate plain lyrics, which is a small extra on Android?
